consequence.statement: The high-scale mode for ipcache will be removed in v1.18; environments using this mode should stop using it before upgrading.

original.statement: The high-scale mode for ipcache has been deprecated in v1.17.0 and will be removed in v1.18.

decision.reason: [ev-21e07cf98d97] lists the ipcache high-scale mode under "Deprecated Options" in the 1.17 upgrade notes and says it "will be removed in v1.18". That means it still works in 1.17 and is only scheduled to break later, so "deprecation" (review) is the right kind. Nothing in the evidence says anything fails, is rejected or stops being honoured in 1.17. The statement's advice to stop using the mode before upgrading refers to the v1.18 removal, which is consistent with the evidence.
